problem_statement: When NVS experiences a power loss during the last ATE write at the end of a sector, the sector becomes logically full (no erased space remains for data writes). nvs_mount() fails to mount the filesystem in this case, returning an error, when it should instead treat the sector as closed and proceed successfully, triggering garbage collection on the next write to restore a writable sector.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p qemu_x86 -T tests/subsys/fs/nvs -s tests/subsys/fs/nvs/filesystem.nvs -s filesystem.nvs -O twister-out --no-clean -W
